I have worked this small plot since my mother showed me how, and I feed it with manure from our cow because I cannot afford to buy fertilizer from the cooperative. I will weed it with my own hands and my daughter will help when she is free from the other fields, and I will not spend money on chemicals or hired workers for this little piece. The rains have always been enough for these plants, and I use the same suckers and cuttings my family has kept for generations.
